root_cause: AnimatedCrossFade sizes itself through AnimatedSize, whose outer size was computed in a constraint builder before the child was laid out; the child size reached the state through a size observer, so a child size change showed one frame late.
change: Frame-order pass: fixed through the AnimatedSize layout-time change (see switchers-002); animated_cross_fade.rs unchanged.
note: Confirmed diverging before the fix (Incular-side rerun against existing Flutter traces).

root_cause: AnimatedSize.build computed the outer size from the animation and the begin/end sizes before the child was laid out; the child-size observer restarted the animation during the child's layout, after the box size was fixed, so a retarget first advanced along the old tween. Flutter's RenderAnimatedSize.performLayout lays the child out, runs the state machine, then sizes the box from the restarted animation in the same layout.
change: Frame-order pass: crates/incular-widgets/src/animated_size.rs: the box is a new child-sized layout whose closure runs RenderAnimatedSize.performLayout after the child layout (tight reset, _layoutStart/_layoutStable/_layoutChanged/_layoutUnstable, constrain(_animatedSize), alignChild from the child size); the build no longer reads the animation. Layout support (out of list, smallest change): crates/incular-widgets/src/custom_layout.rs (CustomLayoutDelegate::ChildSized + ChildSizedLayout, doc-hidden), crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/layout/behavior/containers.rs (layout_custom arm: child first, then the closure), crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/widget/structure.rs (widget type for the new variant).
harness: switchers__animated_size_retarget: match (was diverging at frame 11, 176 ms); switchers__ 13/13, implicit__ 19/19, transitions__ 9/9 match
limitations: Clipping is always applied to the box (Flutter clips only on visual overflow); visually identical.
note: Earlier pass fixed the overshoot panic.

root_cause: AnimatedSwitcher reduced each transition to its sampled fraction before calling the builder, so a custom builder could not read the status or compose the animation.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/animated_switcher.rs: each entry keeps a CurvedAnimation (switch-in curve, reverse_curve = switch-out curve) as a DoubleAnimation; new additive AnimatedSwitcher::animated_transition_builder(Fn(Widget, DoubleAnimation) -> Widget) and the AnimatedSwitcherAnimatedTransitionBuilder type. transition_builder(Fn(Widget, f32)) is unchanged. Exported from crates/incular-widgets/src/lib.rs.
api_change: additive: animated_transition_builder and AnimatedSwitcherAnimatedTransitionBuilder; the scalar transition_builder keeps working; calling either replaces the other
limitations: None known for the animation handle. Flutter's switch-in/out curve direction is handled by incular_animation's CurvedAnimation rather than the entry's own curve_direction tracking; the scalar path still uses the entry tracking.

root_cause: Flutter 3.41.7 accepts reverseDuration on AnimatedSize, but RenderAnimatedSize's state machine only calls forward and forward(from: 0). No reachable reverse run exists whose timing could differ.
change: none
api_change: none; a source-level reverseDuration setter would be a no-op
limitations: API-compatibility only. Add the setter if source-level parity of the builder is required.
note: Confirmed by reading rendering/animated_size.dart:309-374 in Flutter 3.41.7.

root_cause: Collection controllers ticked only in update_compositor, after layout.
change: Frame-order pass: no change needed. The residual pass's pre-layout sliver tick (WidgetTree::tick_animations -> tick_sliver_viewports_before_layout, interaction.rs) also ticks AnimatedList/AnimatedGrid render slivers, so the removal lands in the frame its animation completes.
note: No dedicated regression test added; the scenario covers it.

root_cause: ImplicitState.build read the curve from the current widget on every build, so a curve-only update changed the displayed fade at once. Flutter's AnimatedWidgetBaseState keeps the running tween and its curve until the next target change (didUpdateWidget only rebuilds the curve and re-evaluates tweens when a target changed).
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/implicit_animations.rs: ImplicitState keeps the curve in effect (set at creation and at each target change, used for both the retarget evaluation and build); curve-only updates leave it unchanged.
limitations: Duration-only updates are not separately framed. A target change that also changes the curve retargets with the new curve, as Flutter does because _createCurve runs in the same didUpdateWidget.
note: Flutter source for the curve change: packages/flutter/lib/src/widgets/implicit_animations.dart:387-409.

root_cause: Same as text-011: at fractional font sizes round(ascent) + round(descent) differs by 1 px from round(ascent + descent).
change: crates/incular-text/src/engine.rs snap_line_boxes (see text-011).
harness: implicit__default_text_style__text_style: match; transitions__text__default_style: match; implicit__ 19/19, transitions__ 9/9.

root_cause: AnimatedContainer, AnimatedPadding, AnimatedAlign and AnimatedFractionallySizedBox accept only physical Alignment and EdgeInsets. Flutter accepts AlignmentGeometry and EdgeInsetsGeometry and interpolates them through direction-aware tweens.
change: none
harness: none (source review; no frame twin can express the input)
api_change: would be additive, but it touches four widget APIs, the padding and alignment tweens and the direction resolution path
limitations: The API surface is too large for this pass. Needs the directional geometry values in incular-config (Alignment, EdgeInsets directional types) to be threaded through the four implicit widgets with the text direction resolved at build time.

root_cause: Opacity in Incular is paint-only for hit testing and always keeps child semantics (tree/descriptors.rs:1279-1295). Flutter omits child semantics at zero opacity unless alwaysIncludeSemantics is true.
change: none
harness: none (the frame recorder does not expose semantics)
api_change: needs an Opacity policy field in the descriptor and the semantic projection
limitations: The descriptor and semantics code are outside this group (tree/descriptors.rs, tree/semantics.rs, sliver_fade.rs). Required change: an always_include_semantics option on Opacity and SliverFade that the semantic projection reads; default false.

root_cause: AnimatedPhysicalModel always built a rounded-rectangle PhysicalModel, although PhysicalModel already has a shape field (painting_effects/layers.rs:91) that Flutter's AnimatedPhysicalModel forwards.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/implicit_animations.rs: AnimatedPhysicalModel gains a shape field (default Rectangle) and a shape(BoxShape) setter, applied immediately to the PhysicalModel as Flutter does.
harness: implicit__physical_model__color_elevation_radius: still matches (the recorder does not measure shape)
limitations: The test compares paint output for the two shapes; it does not check circle geometry in pixels.

root_cause: DefaultTextStyle carries only a TextStyle (incular-widgets/src/environment.rs:230). Flutter's DefaultTextStyle carries textAlign, softWrap, overflow, maxLines, textWidthBasis and textHeightBehavior, and Text reads them from the inherited scope.
change: none
api_change: would extend the inherited DefaultTextStyle scope and Text's inherited reads
limitations: Owner is the environment and text worker (environment.rs and the text widget). Required change: the scope fields plus Text reading them when its own options are unset.

root_cause: SlideTransition::from_animation mapped the sampled offset straight to FractionalTranslation, with no text-direction input, so RTL offsets were never mirrored.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/explicit_animations.rs: new SlideTransition::from_animation_in_direction(position, Option<TextDirection>, child); RTL negates dx. from_animation keeps its behavior (delegates with None).
limitations: No ambient-Directionality lookup: Flutter's SlideTransition also uses only the explicit textDirection. transformHitTests (transitions-002) is not part of this group.

root_cause: The renderer-neutral Transform descriptor (tree/descriptors.rs:1375-1454) has no filter-quality field, so Scale, Rotation and Matrix transitions cannot pass Flutter's filterQuality to Transform.
change: none
harness: none (filter quality is not recorded by the frame harness)
api_change: would add filter quality to the Transform descriptor and the three transition constructors
limitations: Needs the descriptor field (tree and layout/basic/transforms.rs, owned by the layout worker) before the transitions can forward it. Required change: a filter_quality field on the Transform descriptor, then a filter_quality setter on the transitions in animation_transitions.rs and explicit_animations.rs.

root_cause: RelativePositionedTransition required TweenAnimation<Rect>, so a null (Rect?) endpoint could not be expressed.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/animation_transitions.rs: RelativePositionedTransition::from_optional_rects(parent, begin: Option<Rect>, end: Option<Rect>, size, child). A None endpoint is the zero rectangle, which matches Flutter's Rect.lerp for one null endpoint (it scales from the origin) and gives zero for two.
limitations: A both-null sample at every point is the zero rectangle, which is what Flutter's null-to-Rect.zero rule gives. Rect.lerp's other null handling is not separately framed.

root_cause: DecoratedBoxTransition takes TweenAnimation<BoxDecoration>. Flutter takes Animation<Decoration>, so ShapeDecoration and other Decoration types can animate through it, and DecorationTween has mixed-type lerp rules.
change: none
api_change: would need a renderer-neutral Decoration enum over BoxDecoration and ShapeDecoration plus Flutter's DecorationTween rules for mixed types
limitations: API surface too large for this pass. Incular has ShapeDecoration (painting_effects/shape_decoration.rs) but no decoration interpolation type that covers both.

root_cause: SliverFadeTransition::new takes OpacityController only (scrolling/sliver_fade.rs:16-33), so a curved or composed Animation<double> cannot drive it.
change: none (sliver_fade.rs is owned by the slivers worker and was not edited)
harness: transitions__sliver_fade__opacity: still matches with the controller form
limitations: Needed change for the slivers worker: a SliverFadeTransition::from_animation(DoubleAnimation, child) that updates opacity from the animation (the existing controller constructor kept). The transition's animation read can use the same listener path as FadeTransition::from_animation in explicit_animations.rs.

root_cause: Flutter's AnimatedWidget is a Dart base class that subclasses override with build(). Under rule 8 (Rust-first design) the equivalent is a closure-driven builder over a listenable.
change: none
limitations: Incular exposes AnimatedBuilder and ListenableBuilder for the same subscribe-and-rebuild behavior. A subclassable base is not part of the Rust-first API.

root_cause: SizeTransition::fixed_cross_axis_size_factor clamped a negative factor to zero with max(0.0). Flutter asserts that the value is non-negative.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/animation_transitions.rs: the setter asserts factor >= 0.0 (panic with the Flutter name in the message) instead of clamping.
api_change: behavior: a negative factor now panics at construction (previously silently clamped)
limitations: Flutter asserts only in debug builds; this always asserts, following the crate's Size::new convention.

root_cause: No named RelativeRectTween existed; the positioned twin used the generic TweenAnimation<RelativeRect>.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/animation_transitions.rs: RelativeRectTween (new, begin, end, begin(), end(), lerp(t), animate(parent) -> TweenAnimation<RelativeRect>); exported from crates/incular-widgets/src/lib.rs.

root_cause: StatusTransitionWidget is a Flutter base class with no framework subclass in 3.41. Its purpose, a rebuild on status changes that does not depend on value, is covered in Incular by DualTransitionBuilder's effective status and value-driven builders.
change: none
limitations: Source compatibility with a StatusTransitionWidget base is not a goal under ARCHITECTURE.md rule 8.
note: Low priority per the finding; the status-only rebuild is achievable with AnimatedBuilder reading status().
